fields.text: One continuous take. Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite renders a 5 s opening shot; MiniMax H3 Max Turbo Extend continues the SAME clip twice (each extension starts from the previous last frame and returns the full extended video), following a new story beat each time. Result: one unbroken ~15 s camera move, no cuts. Mureka BGM scores it via Soundtrack.

Low camera at water level follows a small white folded-paper sailboat as it floats down a narrow rain-filled stone gutter after a storm, warm golden-hour sunlight, wet cobblestones, a few fallen autumn leaves drifting beside it. One continuous tracking shot, no cuts.
The same paper sailboat tips over a small step in the gutter, splashes down, rights itself and keeps sailing; the camera keeps following it at water level. Continuous shot, no cuts.

The gutter opens onto a wide, still rain puddle that mirrors the orange sunset sky; the paper sailboat glides out to the middle and slows, and the camera rises gently to reveal the sky reflected around it. Continuous shot, no cuts.

nodes.name: Extend +5 s again · H3 Max Turbo
